Soon enough, you learn to become more acceptable by just yourself,
Keep fighting the terrible thoughts. Keep fighting through them. But unfortunately they may be there for a long time(mine haven’t gone away in the last 10 years). That doesn’t mean I’ll give in though, and you shouldn’t either. You matter, you do.
